assay: bulk RNA-seq, human vastus lateralis (young adults, n=9 with RNA-seq per time point)
primary_estimand: Effect of 2-wk unilateral knee-brace immobilization (disuse atrophy), ~7 wk return to habitual ambulation (recovery), and 2-wk repeated immobilization on the muscle transcriptome; no exercise intervention is sampled
inclusion: Baseline/Atrophy/Recovery/Repeated Atrophy biopsies, n=9 each (FIG1 legend)
paper_method: DESeq2 median-of-ratios within Partek Flow (S2.14.p1); pairing handling not stated
exercise_content: Recovery = participants returned to their normal ambulatory activity (S2.3.p1); they were told to refrain from strenuous exercise 24 h before biopsies; the supervised resistance training was offered only AFTER the study and was not biopsied (S2.3.p1)
